security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; worker-src 'self' blob:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: Map and design REDCap surveys, offline
bundle.longDescription: See the structure and branching logic of a REDCap project as a zoomable map, design or edit surveys by drag and drop, and export REDCap project XML, data dictionaries and agent-ready codebooks. Everything runs on your computer.
